comment: Every balance number in Alpine Resort Simulator. Leaf = {value, min, max, unit, comment}. Curves = {xs, ys, comment}. Code reads by dotted key (e.g. snow.freshDensityKgM3) and never embeds a number. min/max are the real-world anchor range the value was chosen from; the value is designer-editable without recompiling.

resortOpenHour.comment: Lifts open; day mode begins. Typical alpine resort 8:30-9:00.

resortCloseHour.comment: Lifts close; night mode (vehicle operation) begins after sweep.

nightShiftStartHour.comment: Grooming may start once patrol sweep is done.

guestsPerAgent.comment: Cohort size: one simulated agent represents this many guests. 1 = every guest individual. Tests raise it for speed.

aiVehicleTickDivisor.comment: AI-driven vehicles integrate every N ticks with dt*N (LOD). Player vehicle always 1.

mapSizeM.comment: Heightmap edge at 1 m; 2048 = 4.2 km2. Region expansion to 12-20 km2 is M8.

snowCellSizeM.comment: Snow grid cell edge over the skiable envelope.

freshDensityKgM3.comment: Density of the loose layer as tracked; fresh cold snowfall 70-150 kg/m3 (Judson & Doesken 2000).

snowfallDensityKgM3.comment: Density at which snowfall is deposited; converted to loose depth at freshDensity.

compactedLooseDensity.comment: Density of loose snow after one track pass folds it into the pack.

settledLooseDensity.comment: Density of loose snow that settles under its own weight.

settleFracPerHour.comment: Fraction of the loose layer that settles into the pack per hour (fresh snow settles ~50% in a day).

compactionReferenceKpa.comment: Ground pressure that gives full compaction effect; groomer tracks 4-8 kPa.

compactLooseFractionPerPass.comment: Fraction of the loose layer folded into the pack by one full track pass at reference pressure.

compactionTargetDensityByKpa.comment: Packed density a track/tyre pressure drives toward (kPa -> kg/m3). Tracks 4-8 kPa, wheel loaders 60+, trucks 200+.

compactionRatePerPass.comment: How far one pass moves density toward its pressure target.

rutPerVehiclePass.comment: Roughness added by one track/tyre pass on soft snow.

rutSoftDensityLo.comment: Below this density snow ruts fully.

rutSoftDensityRange.comment: Above rutSoftDensityLo + this, snow stops rutting.

corduroyDensityLo.comment: Lower edge of the groomed corduroy density band (measured groomed piste 450-550).

corduroyDensityHi.comment: Upper edge of the band; above it the pack reads as hard/icy.

tillerHardeningRange.comment: Work hardening per pass fades to zero this far above corduroyDensityHi, so ice (700) is an asymptote, not a wall.

tillerTargetDensity.comment: Density a full-width tiller re-lays the pack at (before the compaction bar).

tillerCompactionPerPass.comment: Compaction-bar / work-hardening increment per pass. From fresh snow ~3 passes reach the band; ~9 passes with no new snow push past 600 into ice.

tillerMoistureRetain.comment: Moisture kept after tilling (aeration dries the surface).

roughnessPerSkierPass.comment: Roughness added per skier crossing a cell (x0.4 on hard pack, x1 on soft). ~200 passes on a groomed centre lane build moguls; a busy day puts 150-300 passes on the centre lane.

skierIceRoughnessFactor.comment: Roughness multiplier on icy snow (skiers scrape rather than rut).

scrapeKgPerSkierPass.comment: Snow mass a skier scrapes off a cell per pass on soft snow, moved downhill and to the edge.

scrapeEdgeShare.comment: Share of scraped mass pushed toward the run edge rather than downhill.

scrapeSlopeRefDeg.comment: Slope at which scraping is fully effective.

scrapeMaxFractionPerPass.comment: Never scrape more than this fraction of a cell's mass in one pass.

meltMmPerHourPerDegC.comment: Degree-hour melt factor (snow water equivalent 2-4 mm/day/C ≈ 0.1-0.17 mm/h/C of water; expressed as snow depth of runoff density).

meltRunoffDensity.comment: Density used to convert melt depth into mass removed.

sunMeltMmPerHour.comment: Additional melt on a fully sun-exposed cell under clear sky near 0 C.

sunWarmingC.comment: How much full sun warms the snow surface above air temperature.

rainMeltFactor.comment: Snow depth removed per mm of rain.

windScourFracPerHourAt50kmh.comment: Loose snow lost per hour at 50 km/h wind (scales with wind squared).

moisturePerMeltMm.comment: Moisture gained per mm of melt.

moistureFreezePerHour.comment: Moisture removed per hour by refreezing.

refreezeBelowC.comment: Snow temperature below which wet snow refreezes.

refreezeDensityPerHour.comment: Density gain per hour at full moisture while refreezing.

cellTempRelaxPerHour.comment: How fast a cell's snow temperature follows air + sun.

skierLoosenKgPerPass.comment: Pack chopped into loose granular snow per skier pass; the next tiller pass re-mixes it and pulls density back down, which keeps nightly grooming sustainable.

minCoverageMm.comment: Depth below which a cell counts as not covered (thin cover, rocks show).

densityBandLo.comment: PQI density window low edge (softer than this is slow and ruts).

densityBandHi.comment: PQI density window high edge (harder is icy).

densitySoftLo.comment: Score falls to 0 this far below the band.

densitySoftHi.comment: Score falls to 0 this far above the band (ice at ~700).

bareCapFactor.comment: PQI multiplier at zero coverage (a bare run is never good).

saltMeltMmPerHourPerKgM2.comment: Snow melt on salted pavement per kg/m2 of salt.

saltEffectiveMinC.comment: Rock salt stops working below about -9 C.

saltDecayFracPerHour.comment: Salt lost per hour to traffic and runoff.

plowClearanceMmPerPass.comment: Depth a road plow removes per pass (to within a residual).

roadClearMm.comment: Mean snow depth on a road that still scores 100 (hardpack residue).

roadBlockedMm.comment: Mean depth at which the access road scores 0 (cars cannot get up).

lotClearMm.comment: Lot depth for a full score.

rampClearMm.comment: Ramp snow depth for full score (ramps are snow, shaped).

rampBlockedMm.comment: Ramp depth at which a lift cannot load (drifted in).

rampBlockedClearance.comment: Ramp clearance score below which the lift cannot open.

iceDensity.comment: Column density counted as ice on pavement.

icePenalty.comment: Score lost when the whole surface is unsalted ice.

saltFullKgM2.comment: Salt load that fully neutralises ice (20-30 g/m2 typical application).

autoTaskClearanceBelow.comment: Below this clearance the road system posts a plow/clear/blow job automatically.

spreadWhenBelowC.comment: Post a salting job for the road when the air is below this.

clearanceUpdateMinutes.comment: How often clearance scores are recomputed.

accessByClearance.comment: Fraction of demand that reaches the resort by road clearance score.

parkingByClearance.comment: Parking satisfaction factor by lot clearance score.

shearStrengthByDensity.comment: Snow shear strength (kPa) by column density; Shapiro et al. snow mechanics ranges. Ground pressure above this means slip and sinkage.

tractionByDensity.comment: Track/ground friction coefficient by snow density: soft snow is weak, groomed pack grips best, ice is slick.

tireTractionFactor.comment: Wheeled machines get this fraction of tracked traction on snow (chains restore part of it).

chainsTractionBonus.comment: Added to tireTractionFactor when the tyre spec has chains.

sinkageFactor.comment: Track sinkage as a fraction of loose depth scaled by pressure/shear ratio.

rollingResistanceBase.comment: Rolling resistance of tracks on groomed snow.

rollingResistancePerSinkageM.comment: Extra rolling resistance per metre of sinkage (deep fresh snow is hard work).

driveEfficiency.comment: Hydrostatic/powershift drivetrain efficiency engine to track.

spinInPlaceYawRadS.comment: Skid-steer counter-rotation yaw rate at standstill.

maxYawRadS.comment: Yaw rate cap for any chassis.

sideSlipDamping.comment: Damping of lateral sliding on side slopes.

articulationMaxDeg.comment: Centre-pivot steering limit for artic haulers and loaders.

wheelbaseFracOfBody.comment: Wheelbase as a fraction of body length (Ackermann yaw).

bladeFrictionCoeff.comment: Resistance coefficient of snow sliding along a blade.

bladeSpillFracPerM.comment: Fraction of the blade load shed to the windrows per metre travelled.

bladeLoadDensity.comment: Density of snow rolling in front of a blade.

tillerDragNPerM.comment: Tiller drag per metre of working width at full depth.

tillerHydraulicLoadKw.comment: Hydraulic power a full-width tiller draws at rated speed (adds engine load).

bladeLiftRatePerS.comment: Blade lift travel per second at full hydraulic warm-up.

blowerIntakeDepthMm.comment: Depth a rotary blower head clears in one pass.

bucketScoopSeconds.comment: Seconds a bucket takes to fill when scooping.

bucketDumpSeconds.comment: Seconds to dump a bucket or a truck bed.

truckLoadTransferRadiusM.comment: A loader dumping within this distance of a haul truck's bed loads the truck instead of the ground.

spreadLaneWidthM.comment: Lane width used to convert kg per lane-km to kg/m2.

wearHoursToFailureAtFullLoad.comment: Hours of full-load work that take a subsystem from new to failure at wear rate 1.0 (cat rebuild interval 6,000-8,000 h).

wearIdleFraction.comment: Wear at idle as a fraction of full-load wear.

trackWearPerSlipHour.comment: Extra track wear per hour of full slip.

attachmentWearPerWorkHour.comment: Attachment wear per hour of work (blade edges, tiller teeth).

failureRateByWear.comment: Multiplier on 1/MTBF failure rate by subsystem wear.

repairCostFracByWear.comment: Repair cost as a fraction of purchase price by wear at failure.

repairHoursBase.comment: Base workshop hours for an unscheduled repair.

hydraulicResponseLossAtFullWear.comment: Implement speed lost at hydraulic wear 1.0.

coldStartBelowC.comment: Below this ambient temperature unsheltered machines cold-start.

coldStartFailProbByTier.comment: Probability a cold start fails outright, by tier.

coldStartDelayS.comment: Cranking time added on a cold start.

warmupMinutes.comment: Minutes until hydraulics reach full performance from cold.

unshelteredWarmupMultiplier.comment: Warm-up time multiplier for machines left outside.

shelteredTempBonusC.comment: How much warmer a garaged machine starts than ambient.

fuelReserveWarningFrac.comment: Low-fuel warning and AI return-to-depot threshold.

playerReachM.comment: Distance within which Enter takes the nearest machine.

aiLaneOverlapFrac.comment: Tiller lane overlap fraction when grooming.

aiStuckSeconds.comment: Seconds at near-zero speed under throttle before reversing.

aiSlopeMarginDeg.comment: Operators refuse slopes steeper than their rating minus this margin.

routeSnapRadiusM.comment: Max distance to snap a route endpoint to the road/piste graph.

routeStraightMaxM.comment: Below this distance vehicles drive straight instead of routing.

dieselPricePerL.comment: Diesel delivered in bulk, brief 1.00-1.60 with seasonal volatility (fleet system varies it).

gasolinePricePerL.comment: Gasoline for snowmobiles and walk-behind machines.

serviceTruckRefuelLPerMin.comment: Field refuel rate from the service truck.

windExposurePer100m.comment: Wind at the top terminal rises this fraction per 100 m above the base (ridge exposure).

singlesLineCapacityFactor.comment: Singles line fills empty seats: +5-10% effective capacity.

noMazeCapacityFactor.comment: Without a loading maze the load zone runs ragged.

capacityAtZeroCondition.comment: Capacity factor of a worn-out lift (slowed for safety).

breakdownRateAtZeroCondition.comment: Breakdown rate multiplier at condition 0 (1x at new).

breakdownRepairHoursMean.comment: Mean downtime of an unscheduled stop (drive fault, rope position sensor, grip test).

breakdownCostFracOfCapex.comment: Repair cost of a breakdown as a fraction of capex.

inspectionHours.comment: Lift closed for a periodic inspection.

inspectionCostFracOfCapex.comment: Periodic inspection fee as a fraction of capex.

inspectionConditionGain.comment: Condition restored by an inspection with adjustments.

conditionLossPerOperatingHour.comment: Condition lost per operating hour (annual maintenance keeps it up).

depreciationYears.comment: Straight-line book depreciation of a lift.

snowReportReferencePqi.comment: Snow report score at which PQI neither helps nor hurts demand.

freshSnowBonusPqi.comment: Above this snow-report score a fresh-snow buzz adds demand.

stormWindKmh.comment: Wind above which the forecast keeps guests home.

stormSnowCmPerHour.comment: Snowfall rate above which driving up is a deterrent.

guestsPerCar.comment: Occupancy per car for parking revenue.

halfDayFromHour.comment: Arrivals after this pay the half-day rate.

lunchProbPerVisit.comment: Chance a cohort at the base in the lunch window eats.

leaveMinutes.comment: Time from deciding to leave until gone.

noLiftPatienceMin.comment: Minutes a cohort waits at the base with nothing to ride before leaving.

leaveAfterGiveUpProb.comment: Chance a cohort that gives up on a queue leaves the resort.

queueRefMin.comment: Queue wait that costs a full queue-weight of satisfaction.

speedFactorAtPqi0.comment: Skiing speed factor on a PQI-0 surface (moguls, ice, bare).

speedRefGradeDeg.comment: Grade at which archetype ski speed applies.

fatiguePerLap.comment: Fatigue per run for an 8-lap-a-day guest.

referenceLapVerticalM.comment: Vertical drop of the lap that fatiguePerLap refers to. A typical mid-mountain run is 250-350 m vertical; an 8-lap day on such runs is about 2,400 m skied.

comfortColdStartC.comment: Below this open chairs get uncomfortable.

comfortColdRangeC.comment: Degrees below comfortColdStartC for full discomfort.

comfortWindRefKmh.comment: Wind for full discomfort on an exposed chair.

satPqiWeight.comment: Satisfaction delta per lap per unit of (PQI/100 - neutral).

satPqiNeutral.comment: PQI/100 that neither pleases nor annoys.

satComfortWeight.comment: Satisfaction scale for ride comfort/weather exposure.

satPriceWeight.comment: Satisfaction penalty per +100% ticket price over the act base.

windExposurePer100m.comment: Wind increase per 100 m of elevation above the base for SampleAt.

snowPerWaterM3.comment: Brief: 1 m3 water -> 2-2.5 m3 machine snow.

machineSnowDensityKgM3.comment: Density of machine-made snow when the gun def gives none.

hoseMaxM.comment: Longest hose run from a hydrant to a gun.

blowbackFactor.comment: Output factor when a gun aims into the wind above 8 km/h.

windDriftMPerKmh.comment: Downwind drift of the plume per km/h of wind at full reach.

pumpKwhPerM3Water.comment: Pumping energy per m3 of water at ~300 m head (brief: 1.5-4 kWh per m3 of snow total).

compressorKwPerM3Min.comment: Compressor power per m3/min of air for lance guns.

nozzleLifeHours.comment: Nozzle set life before output drops 30%.

wetBulbMaxC.comment: Marginal snowmaking threshold shown to the player: fan guns start producing usable snow at about -2.5 C wet-bulb (real practice quotes -2 to -3 C). Each gun's own output curve decides actual production.

minLiftVerticalM.comment: A lift must gain at least this much height.

concreteKgPerM3.comment: Density of concrete hauled by mixer trucks.

workHoursPerDay.comment: Construction crew working day, for build-time estimates.

depositFrac.comment: Equipment order deposit paid at commit.

deliveryFrac.comment: Instalment paid when terminals are placed (equipment delivered).

liftCorridorWidthM.comment: Cleared corridor width under a lift line.

minRunWidthM.comment: Narrowest run that can be cut.

maxRunWidthM.comment: Widest run that can be cut in one project.

maxRunGradeDeg.comment: Steepest segment a run may have (black runs 25-35 deg).

usedListingsPerDefMax.comment: Max used listings per machine class at a refresh.

usedHoursFracMin.comment: Used machines: hour meter as a fraction of the rebuild interval, low end.

usedHoursFracMax.comment: High end (past rebuild = cheap and risky).

hiddenDefectProbPerThousandHours.comment: Chance per 1,000 h that a used listing hides a defect.

inspectionFee.comment: Pre-purchase inspection by an independent mechanic.

leaseMonthlyFracOfPrice.comment: Monthly lease when the def gives no leaseMonthly (36-month lease ~ price).

rentDailyFracOfPrice.comment: Daily rental rate (a peak week costs ~5% of the machine).

tradeInFactor.comment: Dealer trade-in credit as a fraction of resale value.

pmHours.comment: Shop hours for a 250 h service.

pmCostFracOfPrice.comment: PM service cost (fluids, filters, labour) as a fraction of price.

pmWearRecovery.comment: Wear removed from each subsystem by a PM service (adjustments, fluids).

repairWearRecovery.comment: Wear removed from the repaired subsystem.

rebuildCostFracOfPrice.comment: Rebuild cost as a fraction of the new price.

sendOutDays.comment: Days a sent-out repair takes at multiplier 1.

sendOutCostMultiplier.comment: Cost multiplier for repairs sent to a dealer.

expressPartsMultiplier.comment: Cost multiplier when parts are not in stock and must be expressed.

fieldRefuelWorkHours.comment: Service truck time at a stranded machine to refuel it.

fieldRepairWorkHours.comment: Service truck time for a field repair.

fieldRefuelFrac.comment: Tank fraction a field refuel brings the machine to.

shiftMinHoursPaid.comment: Hired operators are paid at least this many hours a day even when idle (half rate).

fuelPriceDailyVolatilityScale.comment: Daily random-walk scale on the depot's price volatility.

autoGroomJobs.comment: Post one grooming job per open piste at resort close. Resorts run a nightly groom plan; 1 = on, 0 = player posts jobs manually.

groomJobPqiBelow.comment: Pistes at or above this PQI at close are skipped for the night (a run skied lightly on a cold day keeps its corduroy).
